class.name: IfcDocumentInformation
class.brief_description: IfcDocumentInformation captures "metadata" of an external document. The actual content of the document is not defined in IFC; instead, it can be found following the reference given to IfcDocumentReference . HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x.

members.member: In IFC2X3 files, this is the [code]DocumentId[/code] attribute. A String, or null when unset.
File name or document name assigned by owner. A String, or null when unset.
Description of document and its content. A String, or null when unset.

Resource identifier or locator, provided as URI, URN or URL, of the document information for online references. IFC2x4 CHANGE New attribute added at end of attribute list. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Purpose for this document. A String, or null when unset.
Intended use for this document. A String, or null when unset.
Scope for this document. A String, or null when unset.
Document revision designation. A String, or null when unset.
Information about the person and/or organization acknowledged as the 'owner' of this document. In some contexts, the document owner determines who has access to or editing right to the document.
The persons and/or organizations who have created this document or contributed to it. An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset.

Date and time stamp when the document was originally created. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDateTime , the date time string according to ISO8601. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.

Date and time stamp when this document version was created. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDateTime , the date time string according to ISO8601. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.

Describes the electronic format of the document being referenced, providing the file extension and the manner in which the content is provided. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.

Date when the document becomes valid. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDate , the date string according to ISO8601. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.

Date until which the document remains valid. IFC2x4 CHANGE The data type has been changed to IfcDate , the date string according to ISO8601. A String in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files, a GDIFCEntityBase in IFC2X3 files, or null when unset.
The level of confidentiality of the document. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.

The current status of the document. Examples of status values that might be used for a document information status include: - DRAFT - FINAL DRAFT - FINAL - REVISION A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
An Array of GDIFCEntityBase entities, or null when unset. Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it is empty.
Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it is empty.
